passage: The first several seconds retain the harbour scene. Later samples show forward travel toward a parapet terminus/descending path, followed by the adjoining cove and damp sand; the village recedes through camera movement rather than disappearing at the paper cut.

limitations: Reference conditioning does not establish exact geometry/pose in every frame; fine feather/limb deformation and continuous performance remain limited by sampled review. Not site reconstruction or footage captured in a physical harbour.
